unresolved.reason: Fallback visa_free is not established. Kenya's current official eTA schedule exempts the published name 'St. Kitts and Navis' for up to 90 days, but it does not identify or map that name to the current Saint Kitts and Nevis ordinary-passport issuer. The same page says visitors need an approved eTA before travel unless exempt; this unresolved name discrepancy does not support either a visa-free or ETA classification for KN.
